mentions.name: TLV message protocol
mentions.description: This project implements a TLV message protocol, a binary data serialization format inspired by MsgPack, CBOR, and Ion 1.1, aiming to be 'JSON without the bloat, Protobufs without the ceremony'. It emphasizes a tight set of core primitives, low-cost extensions, storage of reused values/schemas, and optional pre-negotiation, with attention to encoding/decoding performance.
mentions.problem: Existing formats like JSON carry bloat and Protobufs involve ceremony; the protocol aims to remove those costs.
mentions.audience: For the author's own use in other personal projects
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am currently in the process of implementing a TLV message protocol (think MsgPack, CBOR, etc).

This is something I've been kicking tires on since my time at $BIGCORP; JSON without the bloat, Protobufs without the ceremony.
